senses.gloss:
पिचण्ड पिचण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n. the belly;
a particular part or limb of an animal.

पिचण्डक = पिचण्डे कुशलः, see Gaṇa to Pāṇ.
V. 2, 64; (इका), f. the calf of the leg; the instep.
पिचण्डिक, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably) big-bellied.

पिचण्डिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or पिचण्डिल, अस्, आ, अम्,
big-bellied, corpulent.

पिचिण्ड, अस्, m. the belly or abdomen; a parti-
cular part of an animal.
—पिचिण्ड-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
big-bellied, corpulent.
पिचिण्डिका, f. the calf of the leg; the instep.
पिचिण्डिल, अस्, आ, अम्, big-bellied, corpulent.

पिचु पिचु, उस्, m. cotton; a sort of grain;
the plant Vangueria Spinosa; a Karṣa or weight of
two Tolas; a kind of leprosy; N. of an Asura;
Bhairava or one of the eight faces of Bhairava.
—पिचु-तूल, अम्, n. cotton.
—पिचु-मन्द or
पिचु-मर्द, अस्, m. the Nimb tree, Azadirachta
Indica.
पिचव्य, अस्, m. the cotton plant.

पिचुक, अस्, m. the plant Vangueria Spinosa; a
species of tree.

पिचुल, अस्, m. cotton; the tamarisk, Tamarix
Indica; another plant, Barringtonia Acutangula; a
kind of cormorant or sea crow.

पिच्च् पिच्च्, a various reading for rt. पिछ्,
q. v.

पिच्चट पिच्चट, अस्, आ, अम्, pressed flat,
[]
a substance pressed flat, cake [cf. तिल-प्˚]; (अस्), m.
inflammation of the eyes, ophthalmia; tin, lead.

पिच्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, pressed flat, squeezed; [cf.
चिपिट.]

पिच्चा पिच्चा, f. a collection or string of
sixteen pearls weighing a Dharaṇa; [cf. पिक्का.]
पीच पीच, अम्, n. the lower jaw, the chin.

पिच्चिट पिच्चिट or पिच्चिटक, अस्, m. a species
of venomous insect.
पिच्छोरा पिच्छोरा, f., Ved. a pipe, flute.

पिच्छ, अम्, n. a feather of a tail (especially of a
peacock); the tail of a peacock; the feathers of an
arrow; a wing; a crest; (अस्), m. a tail in general;
(आ), f. the scum of boiled rice and of other grain;
the gum of the silk-cotton tree; the venomous
saliva of a snake; a multitude, heap; the calf of the
leg; a sheath, a coat or cover; the areca-nut, betel-
nut; a line, row, range; a diseased affection of a
horse's feet; a plantain, Musa Sapientum; the Śiśu
tree, Dalbergia Sissoo; armour, a sort of cuirass or
jacket; = पिच्छिल.
—पिच्छ-बाण or पिच्छ-वाण,
अस्, m. ‘whose feathers are like arrows,’ a hawk.
—पिच्छ-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a tail, tailed.

पिच्छक, अम्, n. a feather of a tail (at the
end of a comp.; cf. चित्र-प्˚); (इका), f. the feathers
of a peacock's tail tied in a bunch (used by conjurors).

पिच्छल, अस्, आ, अम्, slimy, slippery, smeary;
(अस्), m., N. of a Nāga of the race of Vāsuki; (आ),
f., N. of various plants, Dalbergia Sissoo, Bombax
Heptaphyllum, Basella Lucida or Rubra; N. of a
river; (perhaps an incorrect form for पिच्छिल, q. v.)
—पिच्छल-दला, f. the jujube, Zizyphus Jujuba.

पिच्छितिका, f. = पिच्छिला, the Śiśu tree, Dalbergia
Sissoo.

पिच्छिल, अस्, आ, अम्, slimy, lubricous, slippery,
smeary; having a tail; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. sauce
mixed with rice-gruel; sauce, gravy or condiments
with water or ghee; broth, soup; moist and split
pulse; (अस्), m. the plant Cordia Latifolia and Myxa;
the tamarisk, Tamarix Indica; (आ), f., N. of various
plants, Dalbergia Sissoo; Bombax Heptaphyllum,
the silk-cotton tree; a pot-herb, Basella Lucida or
Rubra; linseed, Linum Usitatissimum; Asteracantha
Longifolia; an esculent root, Arum Indicum; N. of
a river.
—पिच्छिल-च्छदा, f. Basella Cordifolia.
—पिच्छिल-त्वच्, क्, m. an orange-tree; orange-peel;
a species of fruit tree (= धन्वन).
—पिच्छिल-
सार, अस्, m. the gum of Bombax Heptaphyllum.

पिच्छिलक, अस्, m. a species of fruit tree (=
धन्वन).
